title: AI-Assisted Authoring With Codex
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting ai-assisted authoring with codex to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Specify the instructional interaction precisely enough that the tool implements your design, not its defaults.
Keep design decisions (sequence, feedback, separation of content) with the human author.
Audit generated code for encoded pedagogy errors, not just for whether it runs.
Document each accepted and rejected suggestion with the instructional reason.
